edition: Nestle-Aland 28 (NA28); German Bible Society online running text
authorization: User explicitly authorized NA28 provisionally on 15 October 2026; UBS6/ECM review remains pending.
scope: NA28 is the user-authorized provisional New Testament base. Focused checks of the German Bible Society’s Greek running text are recorded by chapter. This is an English editorial revision, not complete critical-text or apparatus verification. The newer Bespoke PDF’s preferred UBS6 text has not been obtained; UBS6/ECM comparison, full apparatus, independent Greek and human read-aloud reviews remain pending.
historical_records: Existing index and reference records were consulted as historical reference, not proof of fresh complete Greek verification.

chapters.decision: Preserved the promise, pure conscience, night/day, rekindling, cowardice/power/love/self-discipline, pre-age grace, appearing, death and incorruptibility, both deposits, chains and the repeated Lord at 1:18. Ordinary Timothy address and third-person verbs are modernized. Christ Jesus at 1:10 follows the displayed NA28 order; the inherited Jesus Christ remains archived. Sincere faith replaces unhypocritical faith.

chapters.decision: Preserved soldier/athlete/farmer, fruit, seed, chains, death/life/endurance/denial/faithfulness, gangrene, foundation/seal, vessels, youthful desires and snare/capture. Before God at 2:14 follows the displayed NA28 reading in place of inherited before the Lord. At 2:15 the straight-course image is restored from the earlier record. The at 2:18 reflects the bracketed Greek article. Commands to Timothy use ordinary address.

chapters.decision: Preserved each vice-list item and repeated lovers, godliness/power, captivity, the Jannes/Jambres names, the entire sequence of conduct and sufferings, deceiving/being deceived, infancy and sacred writings, God-breathed and all four uses of Scripture. Those from whom in 3:14 makes the consulted plural explicit. Natural English replaces difficult seasons, human beings, unapproved and advance toward the worse.

chapters.decision: Preserved the charge, living/dead, appearing/kingdom, five commands, season pairing, sound teaching, heaping teachers and itching-ear image, pouring out, contest/course/faith, crown/Judge, all names and places, cloak/books/parchments, first defense, lion mouth and heavenly kingdom. Modernized Timothy address and has, and smoothed make every effort, award and did much harm. The final singular your spirit and plural you all remain distinct; no final Amen is added.
